**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

I searched the full agreement for Customer-payable stipulated amounts and found none:

- **§ 6 Termination (p0032–p0033)** — either party may terminate for convenience on 15 days' notice (when no SOW is outstanding) or for uncured material breach; our only payment obligation is fees and expenses "incurred or earned … through the effective date of such termination." That is payment for work actually performed, not an early-termination fee or liquidated sum. The duplicate wind-down clause misfiled as § 7(c) (p0044) says the same thing.
- **§ 3 Compensation (p0013–p0015)** — pure time-and-materials, expenses and taxes. No late-payment penalty, interest charge, minimum commitment or kill fee.
- **§ 7 Limitations of Liability (p0035–p0037)** — mutual cap at fees paid to Contractor plus a mutual consequential-damages waiver, with no penalty or liquidated-damages carve-out from the cap (the hinted risk).

The rule's preferred position is met outright, so the fallback (early-termination fee capped at 3 months' fees) is not engaged. Two items noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged under this rule: Contractor's right to change rates on 30 days' notice (p0014) is a pricing term, not a liquidated amount; and the § 7 heading references "Indemnification of Contractor" with no corresponding operative text, which belongs to the indemnity rule rather than this one.
